title: Service Test 181: FC ice maker harvest

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 36 in Counter-Depth 24 cu ft French Door (W11803249B)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Enable IM switch
steps.body: Verify FC IM switch ON at ice maker.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify FC IM switch ON at ice maker.

steps.title: Continue in Service Test Mode
steps.body: Manual control mode active. Advance to the test step for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Manual control mode active. Advance to the test step for this procedure.

steps.title: Navigate to manual test 181
steps.body: Enter Service Test Mode (any 3 keys ×3 within 8 s). Manual control: 1st button short = enter step list; 3rd button advances to step 181. Confirm with 1st button.

steps.title: Harvest completes
steps.body: Display on then oF — P11-1/P11-2 motor; P70-3/P70-4 position switch. Bale arm up at home?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Display on then oF — P11-1/P11-2 motor; P70-3/P70-4 position switch. Bale arm up at home?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace IM — motor or bale arm down at home.

steps.title: Replace ice maker
steps.oemOutcome: IM motor or position switch failed.
